Interesting Facts
The company has been in existence for over 60 years. Many big names in fashion have played their part in its success through their work in this company, such as Yves Saint Laurent and John Galliano.

Dior has always believed that fashion is fundamentally a holistic thing and everything must be coordinated.   In this sense, perfume is the icing on the cake, and this has resulted in enchanting creations that are created with just as much finesse and stylistic confidence as anything else that may bear the Dior name.

Dior fragrances are known for their high quality and exquisite smell.  Among the most famous perfumes for women are "Miss Dior", which has been around since the company was founded, "Poison", "Dolce Vita" and "J'Adore". The men's fragrances were added a little later. Of these, "Fahrenheit" and "Dior Homme" are known throughout the world.
